contentHtml:
This is a money back guaranteed treatment; if you are not cured we will return your money subject to terms and conditions. Normally patient will get some relief in the first day of our treatment itself, within a week the pain, swelling, stiffness etc… will come down considerably and within 2 or 3 weeks time it will disappear and you may regain flexibility and mobility.  Rare cases it may take few more days. Our treatment is divided in to two parts, one is panchakarma (detoxification)  therapy, which includes Abhyangam (massage) using specially prepared herbal  oil, Kizhi , Vamana, Virechana (medicated purgation), plus internal  and external medicines.   Here we are using Ayurvedic /herbal/natural medicines for the treatment of Tennis elbow  which are normally free from side effects.

You have to continue the medicines for at least 6 months, this helps in regeneration of degenerated parts and helps preventing further degeneration. We are using different panchakarma  techeniques such as Massage, different Kizhi’s, swedanam (medicated steam bath) plus , internal and external  medication.

 Our challenging offer

If you believe that your Tennis elbow is not curable, come to us, we will cure you. You can even pay after getting the result (no need to pay in the beginning of treatment) for more details regarding this offer visit our challenging offer page.

Medicine

We are using pure Ayurvedic/herbal/natural medicines for the treatment of Tennis elbow. Normally Ayurvedic medicines do not have any side effects, at the same time giving additional side benefits to you. We have our own special medicines, and prepares medicines according to the conditions and requirements of the patients. Medicines vary with condition of the patient. We have our own Medicine Manufacturing unit, having GMP Certificate. We use quality materials for the manufacture of these quality medicines.

Benefits of our treatment

  1. Normally patients will feel relaxed in the first day of our treatment itself and within 2 or 3 days they will feel much relaxed and the severity of the pain will comes down.
  2. Normally in 2 to 3 weeks time pain and inflammation will go and they will be able to move the hands freely
  3. Our medications for Tennis elbow helps in removing the stiffness, swelling etc…   and increase the blood circulation.
  4. Our medicines are free from side effects.
  5. Our treatment helps to remove the side effects of medicines that you have taken earlier.

Duration of the treatment

Normally the patient has to undergo the therapy for three weeks, rare cases it may take some more time. Everybody have to continue the medications for at least 6 months, rare cases it may take some more time.

What is tennis elbow?

Tennis elbow is a condition where the outer part of the elbow becomes sore and tender, it is an inflammation of the several structures of the elbow. It is an overuse injury occurring in the lateral side of the elbow region, it occurs at the common extensor tendon that originates from the lateral epicondyle.
